title: Difference quotients of a C^1 map converge to the directional derivative uniformly on compact sets
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, f : R^n -> R^l, U ⊆ R^n open, K ⊆ R^n compact with K ⊆ U, and e ∈ R^n, and assume f is C^1 on U. Then the difference quotients g_d(x) := d^{-1}(f(x + d e) - f(x)) converge to the directional derivative Df(x)e uniformly for x ∈ K as d -> 0 with d ≠ 0, i.e. along the punctured neighbourhood filter 𝓝[≠] 0 of 0 in R.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (U K : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun (d : ℝ) (x : Rn n) => d⁻¹ • (f (x + d • e) - f x)) (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x e) (𝓝[≠] 0) K
